popups.title: YOUR GOAL
popups.text: This is your opponent. Their Vigor is 25. Bring it to 0 and the duel is yours. Your own Vigor sits just below theirs — guard it.

popups.title: YOUR HAND
popups.text: These are the cards you hold. Press and hold any card and it will tell you what it does. Try it now, then tap anywhere to go on.

popups.title: READING A CARD
popups.text: Top corner: the cost. Bottom left, in red: Strength — the damage it deals. Bottom right, in green: Vigor — how much it can take before it dies.

popups.title: ATTUNEMENT
popups.text: Attunement is what you spend to play cards. You start with 1 and gain 1 more each turn, so early turns are small and later turns are heavy.

popups.title: CREATURES AND LANES
popups.text: Creatures fight from lanes. Tap a creature in your hand, then tap an empty lane on your side to summon it. Go ahead.

popups.title: RITUALS
popups.text: A card with no Strength and no Vigor is a Ritual — a spell. It resolves the moment you play it, then rests in your Barrow.

popups.title: YOUR RELICS
popups.text: These two are your Relics. They are always in play, they never leave, and they belong to your class. Each gathers charges as you play and fires when full. Hold one to read it.

popups.title: THE ENEMY'S HAND
popups.text: Along the top edge you can see how many cards your opponent is holding. Plan for what they might be keeping.

popups.title: DECK AND BARROW
popups.text: Your Deck is what remains to draw. The Barrow is where your dead and spent cards rest. Some cards claw their way back out — that is Unearth.

popups.title: END TURN
popups.text: When you are finished, End Turn. Your opponent takes theirs, then you draw a card and gain Attunement.

popups.title: ATTACKING
popups.text: A creature that began your turn on the board is ready. Tap it, then tap an enemy lane. An empty lane sends the damage straight to their Vigor. An occupied lane means the two creatures trade blows.

popups.title: KEYWORDS
popups.text: Some creatures carry a word — Guard, Pierce, Venom, Unearth. Hold the card to read it. Learn Guard first: a Guard creature shields the lanes beside it.

popups.title: GOOD HUNTING
popups.text: That is everything you need. Reduce their Vigor to 0. Good hunting.
